numeric_claims.nearby_text: - **SNOW_CLAIM_002**: SNOW has validated revenue TTM of $4.34B, so the business discussion should focus on product revenue, NRR, RPO, AI Data Cloud adoption and consumption growth rather than generic scale language.

- **SNOW_CLAIM_010**: The bull case is that AI Data Cloud adoption, product revenue growth and RPO conversion combines with revenue of $4.34B to support the allowed upside rating path when cash conversion quality also holds.

- **SNOW_CLAIM_012**: The bear case is that consumption slowdown, GAAP losses, SBC dilution or weak FY plan overwhelms validated FCF quality and leaves the stock vulnerable if SBC/Revenue at 26.4% or source-quality issues persist.
